Finally. 🙏

Yet…my uni forgot about me.

Those once helping haven’t spoken to me in a year. 

I lost EVERYTHING. 

Just pretended to care? 

@WellingtonUni is there justice for #MeToo? 

University bans intimate relationships between staff, students https://t.co/wkGMMVlSBX

Who can fucking help me? Who sees me as worthy enough to seek MY justice & return from the disgusting country and abusive family I fled from in the first place?  When will my life matter enough??
I just need Vic Uni to give a single shit….well over a decade later.
 #FML #MeToo

Took well over a decade to finally believe internally: I deserve(d) SO. much better. 
I deserve to get my life & future back. I deserve my Uni to make amends for my injustices & help me return. 
I deserve dignity. Do I matter, @WellingtonUni?
 #MeToo 

https://t.co/im3Psj1RXO

I was in contact with the university last year, as well as a reporter, but since then, literally everyone gave up or forgot about me. I’m used to being invalidated, abandoned, & disrespected, but I’ll no longer tolerate that. I’ve come too far. #MeToo #vicunialum #GoFundMe
